events.title: 1st Anniversary – Phase 2
events.description: Lucky Drop, Hero of the Festivities, new Battle Pass Amusement Park Pass, Thrilling Bingo, Cumulative Recharge, Token Exchange and the Amusement Park Gift Bundle.

events.title: 1st Anniversary – Phase 3
events.description: Alliance Fireworks Festival and new Supply Packages.

events.title: [Web Shop] 2026 Golden Festival Event
events.description: Web Shop bonuses and limited-time deals.

events.title: [Web Shop] Lucky Draw Cumulative Rewards Event
events.description: Bonus rewards in the Web Shop based on the total number of Lucky Draw draws.

events.title: Vaccine Lab Alliance Tournament
events.description: Alliance tournament: the top Alliances of each World face off in a series of battles up to a final round. Applications open on Mondays.

events.title: World Transfer Event
events.description: Move to another World of the same group in 3 phases (preparations, advance invitations, free transfer). Powerhouse Worlds accept 20 Operatives, Standard Worlds 50.

patches.name: The 1st Anniversary event will begin
patches.notes:
The 1st Anniversary event will begin.
Gen 6 Heroes have been released.
Max Hero Lv. will be raised to Lv. 100.
A new Grade has been added for Heroes, and the max Rank will be increased to 8 -Star.
A new Grade has been added for Gear.
A new "Hero Costume" system has been added.
A new "Ruins" system has been added.
Various quality of life improvements and system optimizations have been implemented.
